description: This header file declares functions related to optimization passes for concatenation operations in the Torch JIT graph, including elimination of common inputs, expansion of concat operations into copies, and combining concat nodes.

methods.name: EliminateConcatCommonInputs
methods.description: Eliminates common inputs among multiple `aten::cat` operations within the graph.

methods.name: ExpandConcatAndEliminateRedundancy
methods.description: Expands `aten::cat` operations into `aten::copy` ops and removes redundant buffers used for concatenation.

methods.name: CombineConcats
methods.description: Attempts to optimize the graph by combining multiple concat operations into fewer or single operations.
